The '''Bimmiel asteroid field''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[MZX33291 system|Bimmiel system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] attempted to establish a minefield there to disrupt the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] activity in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], but were [[Battle in the Bimmiel asteroid field|stopped]] by Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Kanz Minefield}}</ref>
